description.en: Curious and talkative, you will never get bored with a gemini! As they are always well informed about the latest trends and love to entertain, their energy and optimism is inspiring and contagious.  This pendant is available in 18 karat gold and sterling silver. Dimensions: approximately 21 x 15 x 2 mm.
